_about: Mrs. Burton Harrison's The Old-Fashioned Fairy Book (undated in the text), fairy tales, closing with a group of romances of the Middle Ages, illustrated by Miss Rosina Emmet, as the title page names her (Rosina Emmet Sherwood in the Gutenberg catalogue). Gutenberg catalogue: Harrison 1843-1920, Sherwood 1854-1948. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
